features.title: Health check and talks API
verify: GET /api/talks returns the seeded talks ordered by slot

features.title: Talks page lists talks
verify: Opening / in a browser shows one card per talk with title, speaker and slot

features.title: Submit a rating via API
verify: stars outside 1-5 or non-integer returns 400 with error code

features.title: Average score and count per talk
verify: GET /api/talks includes avg (1 decimal) and count
a talk with no ratings has avg null and count 0

features.title: Rate a talk from the page
verify: Clicking a star and submitting updates that card's average without reload
an invalid submission shows the API error message

features.title: Leaderboard
verify: GET /api/leaderboard ranks rated talks by avg, ties by count
unrated talks are not on the leaderboard

features.title: Ratings survive a restart
verify: after restarting the server, previous ratings are still counted

features.title: Leaderboard refreshes on its own
verify: a rating submitted by another client appears on an open page within 5 seconds
